verdict.detail: Same country, catalogue number and year as the first issue (US, SD 1556, 1970). Discogs lists 4 variants of it; the run-outs and label details tell the earliest.

notes.text:
A1 and A2 were recorded live at the Monterey Jazz Festival on Sept. 18, 1966. From Atlantic LP 1473.
B1 and B2 were recorded at Atlantic Recording Studios, NYC on Mar. 29, 1966. From Atlantic LP 1459.
B3 was recorded live at the Fillmore Auditorium in San Francisco on January 27, 1967. From Atlantic LP 1481.
